surfaces.use_when: a host can intercept the next unsent tool object and needs card-or-UNKNOWN output
an agent loads repository instructions before consequential operations
a harness discovers portable skills by metadata

surfaces.bootstrap: git clone https://github.com/AaronVick/AGENT_FABLES.git && cd AGENT_FABLES && node bin/agent-fables.mjs verify
surfaces.use_when: assessment and repository data must remain local
a host needs a deterministic deny-by-default consumer example under 50 lines
an MCP host can spawn a local read-only server
a scanner or policy tool needs to emit a stable AF breadcrumb
registry installation is explicitly authorized and independently verified

selection_rule: Choose the first ready surface already supported by the host; do not install, modify repository instructions, or publish without owner authorization.
